exposure: BP evaluation and preeclampsia symptom screening at well-child visits
management algorithm for postpartum hypertensive disorders
cohort: Birth mothers who delivered at the hospital and brought their newborns for well-child checks at 2 days, 2 weeks, and 2 months.
finding: The QI program was associated with an increased rate of readmission for postpartum preeclampsia (5.6% vs 2.1%) and a significantly earlier median time frame of readmission (7.0 days vs 10.0 days) in the post-intervention cohort.
